messages:
sophie: Quick sync — we want to launch a segmented re-engagement + webinar follow-up flow next week. Goal: move people to a successful inference call. Primary metric: `activated_run_completed` within 7 days.

ben: Sounds good. Proposed segments: `inactive_14_60` (no opens 14-60d), `trial_fresh` (signed up last 72h), and `webinar_attendees` (attended live or on-demand).

omar: For `trial_fresh` we should push a code-first quickstart Day0, then Day3 a low-friction sample app, Day6 a benchmark piece. Keep it 3-4 emails.

marta: For `inactive_14_60` I want a win-back sequence: Subject test (Value stat vs Curiosity). Include a short survey in email 2 to learn blockers. I can own the survey flow.

nai: Webinar follow-up: immediate thank-you + recording (send Day0), Day2: highlights + timestamps, Day7: product deep-dive + CTA to try with promo credits. Add a separate CTA for office hours.

henry: I'll wire analytics. Activation definition: user triggers `created_api_key` and `first_inference_success`. I'll create segments in GA + link to marketing attribution. We should use UTM tags: utm_source=newsletter, utm_campaign=reengage_may, utm_medium=email.

newsletter-bot: campaign created: `reengage-may-2026` template `reengage-basic`.

sophie: Subject line variants to test across cohorts: (A) "How teams reduced gen cost 3x" (B) "Want to cut inference cost by 3x?" (C) "Your first inference in 3 minutes". We'll test across trial_fresh and inactive cohorts.

ben: Cadence suggestion: trial_fresh = Day0/Day2/Day6; inactive = Day0/Day4/Day10 + survey; webinar = Day0/Day2/Day7.

omar: For creative: short hero GIF + 2-line code snippet. Example snippet to include:

```
from redwood import Client
c = Client("$API_KEY")
print(c.generate("hello world"))
```

marta: I can draft the survey: 1) What stopped you? 2) Which model did you try? 3) Any infra blockers? Keep it 3 questions.

nai: If we gate the benchmark PDF, we should add an email-only promo code in the download to measure lift. Also recommend a tiny CTA button style to increase clicks.

sophie: Owners: copy = marta/ben, flows = omar (Customer.io), lists = henry, analytics = henry, creative = omar + design (cc @ella), legal = ben to loop. Final review Fri 11am PT, launch Mon 9am PT.

henry: I'll provide CSVs and segment joins. Example filter: `created_at > now()-3d AND source='trial'` for trial_fresh.

newsletter-bot: Reminder: final-review scheduled Fri 11:00 PT  attendees: sophie, ben, omar, marta, nai, henry.

sophie: One more thing — let's add a small personalization token for `last_tried_model` and `avg_latency_ms` in the intro line where available. Should boost relevance.

omar: Will add token placeholders and share test previews by tomorrow.

marta: I'll draft subjects and the 3-question survey by EOD.

ben: I'll run the A/B allocation: 25% traffic for tests, winner auto-promote after 48h if open->activation lifts > 12%.

sophie: Great work. Ping this thread if anyone hits blockers. :sparkles:
